name: C. H. Spurgeon
bio:
Charles Haddon Spurgeon, Baptist preacher in London for nearly forty years, from 1861 at the Metropolitan Tabernacle, where he preached to some six thousand people each Sunday; his sermons were printed weekly and sold around the world.

The Treasury of David (1869-85), his commentary on the Psalms, gives his own exposition of each psalm, followed by notes he gathered from other writers and outlines for preachers.
